name: dashboard
description: Unified workbench: a status band for subagents and mmrun reviews, plus a seven-page pane (Overview / Agents / Reviews / GPU / Timeline / Usage / Progress; Reviews, GPU and Progress show once they have data); the Progress page lists the per-project progress board the main model records each conversation's work on

gpuHosts.title: GPU hosts
gpuHosts.description: Comma-separated ssh host names; a Bash call starting with `ssh <host>` opens the workbench on that host's GPU page.

cacheTtlMinutes.title: Prompt cache TTL (minutes)
cacheTtlMinutes.description: Main thread idle this long: the band warns that the next message rewrites the prompt cache. The TTL read from the transcript, or reported by a model switch, overrides it for the session.

language.title: Language
language.description: UI language. auto follows the settings `language`, then LC_ALL / LANG, and falls back to English.

askSound.title: Chime when another session waits on you
askSound.description: A short chime with the toast of another session asking a permission or failed; only from the session you typed in last.

toastPeerAsks.title: Toast other sessions asking or failed
toastPeerAsks.description: Toast when another session asks a permission or its turn fails.

toastPeerReplies.title: Toast other sessions' replies
toastPeerReplies.description: Toast when another session replies after a turn of two minutes or more.

toastRuns.title: Toast review results
toastRuns.description: Toast when an mmrun model returns, fails or goes stale.
